title: Maintenance of discipline among students of College, or an Institution not maintained by
text:
30. Maintenance of discipline among students of College, or an Institution not maintained by

University.—All powers relating to discipline and disciplinary action in relation to students of a College

30

-----

or an Institution not maintained by the University, shall vest in the Principal of the College or Institution,
as the case may be, in accordance with the procedure prescribed by the Ordinances.
